exposure: obstetric causes (prolonged obstructed labor, caesarean section, instrumental delivery)
cohort: The study included 47 women diagnosed with vesicovaginal fistulas at Dr. Soetomo Hospital between January 2020 and December 2022, with ages ranging from 16 to 69 years.
finding: The study found that vesicovaginal fistulas had diverse etiologies, predominantly surgical complications (42.55%), followed by malignancy (38.29%) and obstetric causes (17.02%), with treatment adjusted to fistula severity.
mod_finding: Obstetric etiologies for VVF included prolonged obstructed labor (50%), caesarean section (37.5%), and instrumental delivery (12.5%).
followup_time: Patients were observed for variable periods, including 12 months after chemoradiation for malignancy, 3 months post-surgical procedure for conservative management, and 1 month after the first repair for a noted failure.
